note: Pole-roots rounds 2 and 3: every source tried for the poles the NGII 2025 sheet left unresolved; fetch/poleRoots.mjs merges these into data/photo/pole-roots.json. A pole moves only when a source resolves its base to <= 0.5 m or two independent sources agree within 0.5 m. Round 2: none did. Round 3 (other-year aerials, 순천시 airmap 2013-2024 at 10-12 cm, registered to the sheet per pole): 2 resolved (`resolved`, verdict epoch-root), 47 stay at their survey seeds, estimated (추정). seedUncertaintyM: the median shift from seed to resolved root of the poles of the same source (data.go.kr 2.43 / 4.99 / 7.45 m; by-eye survey 0-3.07 m, median 1.2 m), an estimate. Round 4 (Kakao roadview 2010-2026, see sources): every estimated pole viewed; 13 show a lamp, signal or median pole near the seed, 6 seeds are a utility or sign pole, the rest show no pole at the seed; none resolved to 0.5 m, so all stay estimated. Round 4 decisions (roadview `roadview.verdict`): absent poles are not drawn (pole-roots verdict rejected), unconfirmed and confirmed stay estimated at their seed, utility-pole and sign-pole seeds are drawn as that object (stages/furniture.mjs RETYPED).

sources.ngii-wide-search: lib/poleShadow.mjs detectPoleRoots on the NGII 2025 sheet over 3.5 m around each seed (the first round searched 1 m around by-eye bases only), top 3 candidates reviewed by eye on 8x and 16x chips; on the 15 resolved poles the same search returns the known shadow roots within 0.05 m (OB0001, OC0060, OC0061)
sources.vworld-z19: VWorld Satellite z19 (data/ortho/vworld-satellite-z19.*) registers to the sheet at 0.00-0.01 m with NCC 0.89-0.95 at all 15 resolved poles, with the same shadows, vehicles and roofs: it is the same 2025 photo, not a second epoch
sources.ngii-other-epochs: NGII publishes 2022-2024 orthophotos of sheet 34702020, but only behind login, cart and the INNORIX client (map.ngii.go.kr); none is available locally or without login. The keyless 순천시 GIS aerials (12 cm, 2022-2024) are All Rights Reserved, internal QA only, and were not used
sources.esri-z18: Esri World Imagery z18 (0.49 m/px, another epoch, strong relief lean) sits 4-6 m north of the sheet; local registration (gradient NCC, +-10 m) reaches NCC <= 0.40 with a 0.3-14 m spread between window quadrants at the 15 resolved poles, so no root can be carried to the sheet within 0.5 m
sources.vr-two-ray: scripts/perf/vr_lamp_bearings.py rays from the 33 resected stations (a8, c3, d4, d5 excluded), each ray required to show the pole ridge at its base rows, pairs crossing at >= 20 deg, sigma from the station yaw residual and 1 px <= 0.5 m: 32 of the 49 poles have no station within 45 m, 14 one, 3 two; no pair qualified
sources.shadow-tip: root = shadow tip moved back toward the sun by h / tan 62 deg; with heights estimated (+-1 m) the along-shadow error is about 0.5 m before the tip is located, so no tip-only pole reaches 0.5 m
sources.suncheon-airmap: 순천시 생활지리정보시스템 airmap WMS (gis.suncheon.go.kr/gs-gate/airmap, keyless, EPSG:5186), layers 2013/2015/2017 10 cm, 2018-2024 12 cm and 2025 25 cm, fetched at 0.125 m over the pole extent (imagery kept outside the repository; site footer 'All Rights Reserved', used for building the model on the owner's instruction). 2025_25cm registers to the sheet at 0.00 m with NCC 0.99 (the same 2025 photo, not independent); the ten 2013-2024 epochs are independent captures (other shadows, cars, paving). Registration per pole: paint-feature NCC (32 m windows, +-4 m) at 9 windows on a 12 m grid around the seed, mean of the windows within 0.4 m of their median (at least 3), sigma = their RMS (0.01-0.19 m); unregistered where fewer than 3 agree (canopy, shade). Per epoch the median sigma over the poles that register is 0.04-0.09 m (13-32 of the 49 poles per epoch); on the 9 placed shadow/by-eye roots the windows agree to a median sigma of 0.02-0.13 m with shifts of 0.0-0.5 m. Bases picked by eye on 12 m chips (24 px/m) and 6 m zooms (48 px/m) of every registered epoch: pole image (relief lean differs per flight), shadow root (sun differs per flight) or the dark base dot
sources.kakao-skyview-hd: Kakao Map skyview HD tiles (map.daumcdn.net/map_skyview_hd, keyless, 0.125 m): registers to the sheet at 0.04 m with NCC 0.95-0.99 at every window, the same 2025 photo, not independent. Kakao's map_skyview_past route returns only the no-data tile at every level
sources.not-reachable: Naver Map satellite and past aerials (map.pstatic.net tiles answer 400 outside the signed web client), Google Earth historical imagery (Earth Pro client only; tile scraping is outside Google's terms), VWorld past-year imagery (only the current Satellite layer is served, the same 2025 photo), NGII 국토정보맵 2022-2024 orthophotos (map.ngii.go.kr: login, cart and the INNORIX client): not used; round 4 (no login): Naver panorama (map.naver.com panorama API 403 outside the signed client), Google Street View (metadata needs an API key), VWorld (no street-level imagery; past-year aerials not served keyless), Wikimedia Commons geosearch (1 geotagged file within 1 km, a portrait, no poles), 순천시 airmap 1948-1994 (25 cm, before the current poles) and the 25 cm resamples of 2013-2024 (same flights as the 10-12 cm layers, not independent)
sources.kakao-roadview: Kakao Map roadview (rv.map.kakao.com node search and map.kakaocdn.net map_roadview HD tiles, keyless, 8192x4096 equirectangular; imagery kept outside the repository): 375 panos within 45 m of the 64 standing poles, epochs 2010-02, 2019-04, 2021-12 and 2026-01; every estimated pole has 2-6 panos within 14 m. Round 4 viewed each estimated pole on 2-3 panos (+-22 deg strips) and records what stands at the seed. Metric test: pano positions (WTM, EPSG:5181 = EPSG:5186 - 100 km N) sit 1.3-3.8 m from the sheet on the controls; ground-plane registration to the sheet (ring 3.5-13 m, NCC 0.2-0.35) fixes some panos (OB0001 at 0.04 m from 11 m) but fails or drifts on others (2.2 m at 20 m, heading flips on plain roads), and bearing rays from adjacent panos cross at 14-26 deg, so no pole reached two independent roadview feet within 0.5 m and none moved
